tagline.en: THUDM's open video model — text-to-video and image-to-video across 2B and 5B checkpoints, with the 2B under Apache-2.0.
tagline.zh: THUDM 开源的视频模型——支持文生视频与图生视频,涵盖 2B 与 5B checkpoint,其中 2B 采用 Apache-2.0 许可。

en: CogVideoX is an open video generation family from THUDM (Tsinghua). It generates video from a text prompt and can also animate a still image into motion, and it has become a common backbone for video-diffusion research and tooling.

The family spans a 2B and a 5B model, including image-to-video checkpoints and the CogVideoX1.5 5B line. The 2B checkpoint is released under Apache-2.0; the larger variants carry an 'other' license, so check terms per checkpoint. Generation parameters like the number of inference steps, frame count, resolution and fps are exposed so you can tune the output.

In WorldFoundry, CogVideoX runs through its in-tree runtimes: 2B text-to-video, 5B text-to-video, and 5B image-to-video are wired up so you pick a checkpoint, give it a prompt (plus an image for image-to-video), and it renders the clip.
zh: CogVideoX 是 THUDM(清华)开源的视频生成家族。它可以根据文本提示词生成视频,也能让静态图片动起来,并已成为视频扩散研究与工具链中常见的主干。
该家族涵盖 2B 与 5B 模型,包括图生视频 checkpoint 以及 CogVideoX1.5 5B 系列。2B checkpoint 采用 Apache-2.0 许可;更大的变体使用 'other' 许可,因此请逐个 checkpoint 核对条款。推理步数、帧数、分辨率、fps 等生成参数均对外开放,便于你调节输出。
在 WorldFoundry 中,CogVideoX 通过其内置运行时运行:2B 文生视频、5B 文生视频和 5B 图生视频均已接入——选一个 checkpoint,给它提示词(图生视频再加一张图),它就会渲染出片段。

whenToUse.en: A strong open choice for both text-to-video and image-to-video, with a size range to trade quality against hardware — start on the Apache-2.0 2B, step up to 5B for higher fidelity.
whenToUse.zh: 无论文生视频还是图生视频,它都是有力的开源选择,且提供不同规模在画质与硬件间权衡——从 Apache-2.0 的 2B 起步,追求更高保真度时升级到 5B。

notFor.en: Note the licensing split: only the 2B is Apache-2.0, while the 5B and 1.5 variants use an 'other' license, so review terms before commercial use. Outputs are short clips rather than long-form video.
notFor.zh: 注意许可差异:仅 2B 为 Apache-2.0,而 5B 与 1.5 变体使用 'other' 许可,商用前请审阅条款。其输出为短片段,而非长视频。

en: Text-to-video and image-to-video in one open family
2B and 5B checkpoints, including the CogVideoX1.5 5B line
Tunable inference steps, frame count, resolution and fps
zh: 文生视频与图生视频同属一个开源家族
2B 与 5B checkpoint,含 CogVideoX1.5 5B 系列
2B 采用 Apache-2.0(更大变体为 'other' 许可)
推理步数、帧数、分辨率、fps 均可调
